_note: DEMO MODEL — illustrative numbers only. Nothing here is a finding, a forecast, or verified data. It exists to show the shape of the signal -> trigger -> shock chain and how the finished tool would behave. Replace every number before anyone treats it as real.
lens: AI exposure in the IT-BPM / BPO workforce

assumptions.note: Dummy anchors. Employment and wage figures are placeholders, not sourced statistics.

signals.name: AI-linked layoff announcements
signals.detail: Large BPO employers publicly attributing cuts to automation, per quarter.

signals.name: Entry-level vacancy decline
signals.detail: Year-on-year fall in advertised entry-level BPO roles.

signals.name: GenAI task exposure
signals.detail: Share of BPO task content technically exposed to generative AI.

signals.name: JKP claim volume
signals.detail: Job-loss insurance claims against the 12-month average.

triggers.name: Joint job fair within 30 days
triggers.condition: Two or more AI-linked layoff announcements land in the same city in one quarter.
triggers.action: Labour dept, skills agency and city hall run a joint job fair; affected workers are matched before benefits lapse.

triggers.name: Expand training vouchers
triggers.condition: Entry-level vacancy decline passes 10% YoY for two consecutive quarters.
triggers.action: Prakerja voucher allocation is expanded and BLK vocational centres open extra intake for displaced entry-level staff.

triggers.name: JKP surge processing
triggers.condition: JKP claim volume runs 30% above its 12-month average.
triggers.action: Surge processing is activated and wage-replacement adequacy is reviewed against actual claim durations.

triggers.name: Sector reskilling roadmap
triggers.condition: GenAI exposure passes 45% of BPO tasks with no reskilling pathway published.
triggers.action: A sector reskilling roadmap is commissioned with the industry association and a published timeline.
